cs.t: I worked from home very briefly (less than three months) while I was a full-time university student and was sharing a room with another student. My setup was basically a "scavenged" setup: I carved four holes in the middle of a single-person ANEBODA ikea wardrobe in order to lower the upper shelf to a desk-like height. This way I had what could be called an "office in a closet" setup. In there i put a 18" monitor and my thinkpad X220. I used the wardrobe doors for post-it, calendars and todo lists. Frankly, it worked quite well. Consider a similar setup if you're tight on either budget or space (or both). Also, a nice thing about that setup is that you can close the door and you don't see your "office"anymore".
